decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to loop through cards in the graveyard to create a powerful combo. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble, Urza's Saga, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, the deck can generate mana and card advantage to eventually win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble also help to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to set up its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the board while ramping up to powerful Eldrazi creatures. By using cards like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to control the opponent's creatures and Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to ramp up mana, the deck aims to quickly cast massive Eldrazi such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek, the Great Distortion. With a mix of control spells and ramp cards, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi threats while keeping the board under control.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by powerful spells like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge. The deck also utilizes cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional utility and disruption. The mana base is carefully constructed with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and efficient dual lands like Sacred Foundry to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana. The goal is to apply constant pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while also utilizing blink effects to protect and recur key creatures. The deck includes a mix of disruption spells and removal to control the board state and maintain tempo. By leveraging blink effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities multiple times and create advantageous board states. The combination of aggression and resilience through blinking makes this deck a versatile and formidable opponent in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and finish the game before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck includes efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, as well as burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage to the opponent or clear the way for attacks. The inclusion of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory help boost the deck's aggression and provide additional tools to secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, supported by burn spells and disruption effects to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, while also maintaining tempo with cards like Thraben Charm and Static Prison. The deck's mana base is built to support a consistent and fast-paced strategy, allowing for explosive turns and putting pressure on the opponent from the start.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Underworld Breach along with various artifact cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that allows for repeated mill and damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thassa's Oracle offer additional ways to win the game. The inclusion of disruption cards like Spell Snare and Lightning Bolt helps to control the game and protect the combo.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's resources while generating card advantage through various means such as Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Mishra's Bauble. Utilizing powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember, as well as disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Psychic Frog, the deck aims to establish board control and outvalue the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to further enhance its game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to use ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to quickly get out Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Control elements such as Karn, the Great Creator and All Is Dust help to disrupt the opponent's strategy while cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command provide removal and damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi threats and control the game through disruptive spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach along with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to create a loop that allows you to repeatedly cast spells from your graveyard. This combo can generate a lot of value by casting multiple spells in a single turn, leading to a potential win condition with cards like Grapeshot or Malevolent Rumble. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber to help with card draw and mana acceleration. Overall, the key concept is to assemble the combo pieces and generate a strong advantage through efficient spellcasting.

The main theme of this deck is ramping up mana quickly to efficiently play big threats like Primeval Titan and use cards like Scapeshift to search for and utilize powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. This combo-centric strategy aims to generate a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with lands and powerful creatures, utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor to speed up the process and create advantageous board states. The goal is to assemble key pieces and execute a game-winning strategy through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck revolves around using a combination of Leylines, tribal synergies, and aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal significant damage. By maximizing the use of multicolored lands and spells, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace while utilizing powerful threats like Scion of Draco, Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. With a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and counter magic like Stubborn Denial, the deck aims to establish board control and press the advantage to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through rituals and mana producers like Ruby Medallion, allowing the player to cast multiple spells in a single turn. The deck also includes card draw effects like Reckless Impulse and Past in Flames to keep the combo going. The deck contains Ral, Monsoon Mage and Grapeshot as finishers to deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to chain together multiple spells in a turn to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

The main strategy of this deck involves applying aggressive pressure on the opponent while utilizing blink effects to generate additional value from creatures with powerful enters-the-battlefield abilities. By combining efficient removal spells, hand disruption, and graveyard hate with creatures like Emperor of Bones, Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, and Ketramose, the New Dawn, the deck aims to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building towards a lethal advantage. Utilizing a mix of creature blink effects and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on an aggressive playstyle, utilizing creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy revolves around creating a strong board presence with fast and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while also providing ways to protect them with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison. The versatile Planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and strong removal spells like Galvanic Discharge provide additional flexibility in handling various threats. The inclusion of control elements like Elegant Parlor and Thraben Charm rounds out the deck's strategy for a well-rounded aggro approach.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through countering opponents' spells, bouncing their creatures, and removing threats from the board. It aims to stall the game using card draw and superior card advantage with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. It also includes powerful board wipes like Supreme Verdict and Terminus to reset the battlefield. The deck utilizes land destruction with Field of Ruin and card filtering with Castle Vantress to maintain control and outvalue the opponent.
